poc_summary: Objective: validate Dedicated capacity for latency-sensitive manufacturing workloads. Plan: 1) Representative prompt set (short control prompts ~20-60 tokens, mid-length diagnostic ~200-400 tokens, long-context multi-turn ~2k-4k tokens). 2) Load tests: step up to target sustained 800 req/s for batched telemetry workloads and 120 req/s for low-latency control path. 3) Soak test: 72-hour continuous run at expected production mix (70% embeddings/inspection inference, 20% operator chat, 10% control). 4) Metrics collection: p50/p95/p99, tail latency, token throughput, GPU utilization, KV-cache hit rates, error rates. 5) Success criteria: p95 <= 150ms for short prompts, p95 <= 250ms for 4k-context multi-turns, sustained throughput within 10% of target with <1% error rate, linear scaling demonstrated across reserved GPUs. 6) Reserved GPU plan: initial proposal 8xH100 (low-latency pool) + 12xA100 (batch pool) with automated routing; adjust after soak.
sla_negotiation_points: p95 latency target: 150ms short prompts / 250ms long-context (measured at edge ingress)
availability SLA: 99.9% (monthly), with credits for downtime > 0.1%
credit calculation: proportional to hours of degraded latency/SLO misses
capacity assurance: reserved GPU delta within 10% on 30d notice, burst capacity options for traffic spikes
